decisions.statement: A value placed in the cluster comes from a secret page and from nowhere else.
One page places its value into every resource and key that page names.
Two secret pages placing a value in one resource at one key is refused before anything is applied.
One page naming a resource and key twice is refused for the same reason two pages are.
A page naming no placement has a value nothing asks for and is read past.
The secret pages are the index's answer for their page type rather than a listing of the checkout.
A manifest asking for a secret no page has is reported rather than passed over.
A plan naming no workload names no namespace to place a secret in, so none is.
Nothing here writes a secret page.

definition: the secret values a plan's manifests ask for, put into the cluster from secret pages
